item.title: Square White Background Sneaker

turns.text: Create one marketplace product photo of a white leather sneaker. Square image, plain white background, just the shoe.

item.tests: Delivers a text-generated marketplace image with the requested square framing and clean white background.

answer_sheet.Background and composition: Plain white background, just the shoe.

must_haves: Exactly one white leather sneaker is shown.
The background is plain white, with no scenery or props.
The entire shoe is visible with space around it.
No promotional text, badges or graphic borders appear.

turns.text: Could you create one marketplace product photo for me? I’m trying to get a listing ready and have probably spent too long thinking about the picture. The product is a white leather sneaker, and the image should be square. I just worry about whether the photo will look right for the listing. Please use a plain white background and show just the shoe.
turns.agent:
I couldn't make the photo. Your Magic Hour account doesn't have enough credits, so it turned down the request. No image was made.

I used the cheapest image option your free plan allows: one 640px square image with the flux-2-klein model, at about 5 credits. The other free models cost the same or more, so trying them wouldn't help.

**To go ahead:** add credits to your Magic Hour account, or wait for your free credits to refill, and let me know. I'll then make the same image: one square photo of a single white leather sneaker on a plain white background, with nothing else in the shot.

**On whether it'll look right for a listing:** I'll ask for a slightly angled view from the front and side, which is the usual main shot for shoes. It'll have soft, even lighting, a faint shadow under the shoe and clear leather and stitching. There won't be any text, logos or extra objects. Two things to keep in mind:
- **Size:** the free plan makes images up to 640px wide. Many marketplaces want 1000px or more for the main photo, so check your marketplace's minimum.
- **Accuracy:** this would be a made-up picture of a white sneaker, not your actual shoe. If buyers need to see the exact item, a photo of your real shoe is the safer choice. If you send me one, I can put it on a plain white background instead (about 5 credits). That would also need credits on the account.
